name: robne-deck
description: Marp presentations: ROS-OCP Native Engine (engineering and customer decks)

scripts.build:eng: marp --no-stdin slides-eng.md --theme-set themes/ -o dist/eng.html --allow-local-files && cp -r assets dist/
